description:
What a wallet holds and what it has been doing: holdings with USD values by default, plus optional PnL, recent activity, Hyperliquid perps, Polymarket positions, NFTs, a known-malicious check and token approvals, each with its own source. Replaces get_wallet_portfolio (still callable). Example: {"address":"0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045","include":["holdings","pnl"]}.

Costs 1 credit; each optional include entry (pnl, activity, perps, predictions, nfts, risk, approvals) adds 1. Every section carries its own source receipt (provider, fetched_at, runtime_status); a section that fails is listed under missing and never guessed.

address.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana.

chain.description: EVM chain for the chain-specific sections (activity, nfts, risk, approvals). Default "eth". Solana is detected from the address.

include.description: Default: holdings. Optional: pnl (DEX trading PnL), activity (recent transfers), perps (Hyperliquid positions), predictions (Polymarket positions), nfts, risk (known-malicious check), approvals (token approvals).

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data (default) or 'markdown' for human-readable text.

name: analyze_wallet
title: Analyze Wallet
